recipes.name: Sweetrolls inspired by Skyrim
ingredients: For the Elder Scrolls Sweet Rolls
225 g (2 sticks) unsalted butter, room temperature
45 g low fat milk (or add as needed for desired consistency)
instructions: For the Yorkshire Pudding

In a bowl, whisk together sifted flour, salt, and pepper. Add the eggs and whisk until smooth, forming a paste. - 120 g all purpose flour sifted - ¼ tsp kosher salt - ¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper - 2 large eggs
Slowly stream in the cold milk while whisking continuously until the mixture is free of lumps. - ½ cup whole milk cold
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and chill for at least 30 minutes (ideally overnight).
Preheat your oven to 425° F. Add a small amount of vegetable oil into each cavity of the muffin tin, then place in the oven to heat for about 10 minutes. - ½ tbsp vegetable oil
Once the oil is hot, remove the muffin tin and quickly pour the batter into each cavity, filling each about halfway. - For the Yorkshire Pudding
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown and puffed. Serve immediately.
For the Elder Scroll Sweet Rolls

In a large bowl, combine the melted butter, warmed milk, honey, and yeast. Whisk until the yeast is dissolved. - 3 tbsp unsalted butter melted - 1 cup whole milk warmed - 2 tbsp honey - 2 tsp active dry yeast
Add the egg, salt, and flour, mixing until a smooth batter forms. - 1 large egg - ½ tsp kosher salt - 2 cups all purpose flour
Grease a muffin tin or ring molds, then divide the batter evenly into each mold. - For the Elder Scrolls Sweet Rolls
Cover with plastic wrap and all the batter to rise at room temperature for 30 minutes, or until it has doubled in size. - For the Elder Scrolls Sweet Rolls
Preheat your oven to 350° F. Bake the sweet rolls for 15 minutes, or until lightly golden and a toothpick comes out clean. let them cool on a wire rack. - For the Elder Scrolls Sweet Rolls
For the Brioche Dough Sweet Rolls
In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. - 510 g all purpose flour - 60 g granulated sugar - 10 to 12 grams instant yeast or - 14 active dry yeast - 15 g kosher salt

Stream in the warm milk, and then eggs, and mix on medium-low speed with the dough hook until the dough begins to come together (about 2-3 minutes). - 120 ml whole milk (warm around 105°F) - 4 large eggs room temperature

Gradually add the butter in 1-tbsp portions at a time, allowing each addition to incorporate before adding the next. Knead until the dough is smooth and elastic, about 8-10 minutes. - 225 g (2 sticks) unsalted butter room temperature
Transfer the dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and allow it to rise for 1-2 hours, or until doubled in size. - For the Brioche Dough
Punch down the dough, then shape it as desired (use a muffin tin or shape into small rolls on a baking sheet). Cover and let rise for an additional 30 minutes. - For the Brioche Dough
Bake at 350° F 20-25 minutes, until golden brown. - For the Brioche Dough
For the Frosting

In a bowl, whisk together the confectioners’ sugar and milk until smooth and pourable. Adjust the milk as needed to reach your desired consistency. - 200 g confectioners’ sugar - 45 g low fat milk (or add as needed for desired consistency)
Generously spoon the frosting over the cooled sweet rolls. - For the Frosting - For the Yorkshire Pudding - For the Elder Scrolls Sweet Rolls - For the Brioche Dough
